questions.prompt: What do you usually have for breakfast?

segments.text: I usually have toast and a cup of coffee for breakfast.
I don't have much time in the morning, so I eat something simple.
At the weekend, for example, I sometimes make eggs or pancakes with my family. It is my favourite meal of the day.
I'm not a big breakfast person, so I usually just have toast and a strong coffee.
Mornings are always rushed, and I would rather sleep ten more minutes than cook.
At the weekend, though, I make a proper breakfast with eggs and fresh bread, and I really enjoy it.
In my home, my mother cooks on weekdays.
She works at a school, but she always finds time to make dinner for us.
On Sundays I help her in the kitchen. Last Sunday, for example, we made a big chicken and rice dish together.
Mostly my partner cooks, because he finishes work earlier than I do.
I do the washing-up and the shopping, which seems like a fair deal to me.
Sometimes I surprise him with a new recipe from the internet, and we eat together at the table.

questions.prompt: What is your favourite meal, and why?

segments.text: My favourite meal is my grandmother's vegetable soup.
It is warm and tasty, and it reminds me of my childhood.
She makes it every winter when the family visits. I always have two bowls with fresh bread, and then I can't eat anything else.
That would have to be my grandmother's vegetable soup, no question.
It is simple, but the taste takes me straight back to winter evenings in her kitchen.
I have tried to copy the recipe many times, but it never tastes quite the same as hers.
